<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0232026-10-0503-33-36" status="unreviewed">de ltar ni tshad ma 'ga' zhig mtshan nyid kyi don dang tha snyad rang gis nges par rang rig pas myong bas mngon sum dang 'gal zhing | <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya pa</rs></note>nges par byed pa'i tshad ma 'am tshad ma ma yin ma nges || 
               dang po ltar na nges byed thug ma myed par <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya pa</rs>'i rig pa</note> 'gyur la gnyis pa ltar na nges byed tshad ma ma yin bar 'dod kyang nges bya la bden ba rtogs pa ma yin ba'i sgro 'dogs gcod pas tshad mar 'gyur ro ||
               <lb n="26b2"/> gnyis pa ni dpyod pa ba dang shes rab 'byung gnas lasogs pas tshad ma thams cad gzhal bya rtogs par byed pa na de'i khyad par duM rang yang rtogs dogs pas tshad ma thams cad rang las nges pa yin no zhes zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
